name: Animated Cards
description: An animated card template from Rico where cards reveal with smooth expressive motion. Great for feature showcases and content feed presentations.

name: Bento Grid
description: A bento grid template where animated cells reveal content in a structured sequence. Great for product showcases and portfolio presentations where you have a lot to show in one composition.

name: Bento: 16:9
description: A 16:9 widescreen bento grid template from Clint. Good for YouTube thumbnails and landscape video content showcases.

name: Bento: 1:1
description: A square-format bento grid template from Clint with animated cells. Built for Instagram posts and 1:1 aspect ratio content.

name: Bento: 4:5
description: A 4:5 bento grid template from Clint for portrait social media formats. Perfect for Instagram feed posts and vertical content showcases.

name: Bento: Modular Showreel
description: A bento grid showreel template from Rico that presents multiple pieces of work in a dynamic modular layout. Great for creative studios and agencies with a range of projects to show.

name: Cascading Squares: Grid
description: A template from Hervé Studio where squares drop into a grid in a staggered sequence. Good for pattern-based intros and structured reveal sequences.

name: Interactive Gallery
description: An animated gallery template where images or cards reveal in an exploratory layout. Works for portfolio sites and creative project showcases.

name: Linear Cards
description: An animated card template with minimal motion and a clean aesthetic inspired by Linear. A natural fit for SaaS and developer tool showcases.

name: Photo Gallery
description: A photo gallery template with smooth elegant transitions between images. Great for photography portfolios and visual storytelling projects.

name: Project Showcase
description: A project showcase template from Vendredi Society with elegant animated reveals and a pace that gives the work room to breathe. Great for agency portfolios and creative case studies.

name: Rewind
description: A rewind effect animation template with a retro VHS-style aesthetic. Works as a creative transition for nostalgic or retro-themed content.

name: Rotating Cards
description: A card animation template where cards flip into view one by one. Great for presenting features or pricing tiers where a reveal adds something to the experience.

name: Share Your Work
description: A social media template made by Fons Mans for sharing creative work. Clean layout and simple motion that lets the work speak for itself.

name: Slideshow Loop
description: A looping slideshow template that cycles through frames without a visible cut. Great for continuous display screens and social carousels where the content should keep moving.

name: Sliding Squares
description: A template where colorful squares slide into position in a staggered sequence. Works for abstract intros and dynamic brand content.
